papers.title: Desktop-Delta Bench: Do Computer-Use Models Understand Desktop GUI Transitions?
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly act through desktop GUIs to complete long-horizon tasks. Current benchmarks primarily measure end-task success or single-frame grounding. Neither isolates whether a model can reconstruct the causal, task-relevant transition produced by an action- crucial for rejecting stale observations, verifying progress, and recovering from failure. This is difficult because inference, remote input, app rendering, and screenshot capture are asynchronous: the next observ
papers.llm_reason: 提出了针对计算机使用代理（CUA）的桌面 GUI 转移理解基准（Desktop-Delta Bench），填补了当前 CUA 评测的关键空白：现有基准只测端到端任务成功率或单帧定位，无法判断模型是否理解'一个动作产生了什么因果转移'。论文点出推理、远程输入、应用渲染、截图捕获是异步的，导致下一帧观测可能滞后于实际状态——这使得'能否重建任务相关的因果转移'成为 CUA 拒绝陈旧观测、验证进度、从失败恢复的核心能力。CUA 是当前最热的 Agent 方向之一（Claude Computer Use、OpenAI Operator 等），一个聚焦转移理解的基准对任何构建桌面/浏览器自动化代理的团队有直接评测价值。证据强度较高（benchmark 本身即评测方法论），但代码/benchmark 公开链接暂无待核验。

papers.title: Spend Experts Where You Are Unsure: Confidence-Adaptive Routing for Mixture-of-Experts LoRA
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) route every token to a fixed number of experts $k$. Tokens differ in how uncertain the model is about them, so a single k over-spends on easy tokens and under-serves hard ones. We observe that the router's output distribution is already a per-token uncertainty signal: peaked mass indicates confidence, while a flat distribution indicates ambiguity. We introduce CARE (Confidence-Adaptive Routing of Experts), which admits experts in a
papers.llm_reason: 针对 MoE-LoRA 路由的痛点提出简洁洞察：路由器输出分布本身就是逐 token 不确定性信号——分布峰值表示确信，平坦分布表示模糊。基于此提出 CARE（Confidence-Adaptive Routing of Experts），按置信度自适应调整激活专家数量，而非固定 k 个。这直接解决了'简单 token 过度分配专家、困难 token 服务不足'的资源错配问题。MoE-LoRA 是高效微调的热门路线，CARE 的设计原则（用路由器已有信号做自适应，无需额外模块）对推理与服务栈的工程优化有直接参考价值。方法论清晰、可低成本验证核心假设，但代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Pass the Baton: Trajectory-Relayed On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) grounds token-level supervision in the student's own trajectory, yet suffers from prefix failure: once the student commits to a wrong reasoning direction, all subsequent generation builds on this deviation, producing misdirected continuations that elicit unreliable supervision and waste compute. We identify a teacher-student continuation asymmetry on failed prefixes, where the teacher tends to redirect while the student continues along the original direction, and con
papers.llm_reason: 精确定位了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的一个具体失败模式——prefix failure：学生一旦在推理前缀上选错方向，后续生成全部建立在偏差之上，产生错误监督并浪费算力。论文识别出师生续写不对称性（teacher 倾向于纠偏，student 倾向于延续原方向），并提出 trajectory-relayed 方法接力纠正。蒸馏是 LLM 训练管线的核心环节，prefix failure 是可观测、可量化的工程问题，对构建推理模型蒸馏流水线（如将大推理模型蒸馏到小模型）的团队有直接方法论价值。证据来自摘要自述的实验观察，代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: CHARM: A Multimodal Graph Foundation Model with Hierarchical Context Modeling for Zero-Shot Transfer
papers.abstract: Graph foundation models (GFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for transferring knowledge across graph domains and tasks. Real-world graphs associate nodes with text, images, and other modalities, making multimodal graphs essential for representing complex entities and relations. Moreover, collecting labels and adapting models for every new graph domain is costly and often infeasible, motivating zero-shot transfer. Unfortunately, zero-shot transfer on multimodal graphs remains underexplored
papers.llm_reason: 提出多模态图基础模型 CHARM，通过分层上下文建模实现零样本迁移，针对真实图节点关联文本、图像等多模态属性的场景。图基础模型（GFM）是正在兴起的趋势，CHARM 把多模态属性和零样本迁移结合，与知识图谱增强 Agent、多模态知识检索的方向相关。作为趋势资产，它提供了'多模态实体表示 + 图结构推理'的参考架构，但与当前 LLM/Agent 软件栈的直接迁移距离中等，需要配合实验验证才能判断具体落地阈值。证据依赖论文正文（摘要截断），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Reinformed Dreamer: An Asymmetric World Model Efficiently Trained through Latent Guidance
papers.abstract: Much like humans benefit from guidance while learning, reinforcement learning algorithms may benefit from additional supervision beyond rewards. Leveraging additional information during training to learn better representations and behaviors has been the focus of asymmetric reinforcement learning. This learning paradigm has proven effective under partial observability when additional state information is available, but also under full observability when more refined state information is available
papers.llm_reason: 将非对称强化学习与 Dreamer 类世界模型结合，通过潜在引导（latent guidance）在训练时利用额外状态信息提升表征与策略质量，训练后丢弃额外信息实现部署时的高效推理。世界模型是 Agentic World Modeling 趋势的核心组件之一，'训练时用丰富信息、部署时用部分可观测信息'的非对称设计原则值得跟踪。但本文聚焦 RL 世界模型训练效率，与纯 LLM Agent 的迁移路径有一定距离，更多属于'世界模型架构'的长期参考。代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: VetClaw: An Edge-Cloud Multimodal Agentic System for Veterinary Disease Screening
papers.abstract: We present VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. VetClaw uses a camera module as an edge sensing device and sends captured images, together with optional symptom descriptions, to a server-hosted vision-language model for zero-shot disease classification. papers.llm_reason: VetClaw 是一个边缘-云端多模态 Agent 系统，用于兽医疾病筛查。其架构设计有一定参考价值：将 Agent 交互与工作流编排分离（边缘设备 OpenClaw 负责调度/工具/通知，LangGraph 管理服务器端 VLM 编排），用零样本分类。但兽医场景本身是高度垂直的，核心贡献是应用集成而非方法论创新。作为长尾资产：边缘-云端 Agent 编排的架构模式可复用于其他物联网/边缘 Agent 场景，但不宜作为重点投入方向。代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Falling Behind Drives Unsafe Development in an Idealised AI Race Experiment
papers.abstract: Technological races create tension between speed and safety: actors may gain by moving faster than competitors, even when risky development is harmful. This is prominent in debates about artificial intelligence (AI), where competitive pressure is often argued to incentivise riskier, less safety-conscious development. We study this using a framed behavioural experiment based on an idealised AI race, in which paired participants repeatedly chose between Safe and Unsafe development under an uncerta
papers.llm_reason: 通过受控行为实验研究 AI 竞赛中的安全-速度博弈：成对参与者在不确定性下反复选择安全或非安全开发，发现'落后感'会驱动不安全开发行为。对 AI 安全治理与政策讨论有参考价值——它用实验证据（而非纯理论）支持'竞争压力激励冒险'这一常见论断。作为长尾资产：安全治理和 AI 竞赛动态是持续重要的议题，方法论（framed behavioural experiment）可迁移。但与工程实践的直接距离较远，更多属于治理/伦理参考。代码/benchmark 不适用（行为实验）。

papers.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies increasingly take the form of action-chunking flow policies built on large pretrained backbones. Such chunks run open-loop, so the policy cannot react to sensory input arriving mid-execution, sacrificing \emph{reactivity}. Replanning more often would restore it, but the perception-to-action pipeline (a large backbone plus multiple denoising steps) is too slow: this \emph{latency} forbids frequent replanning and leaves committed actions stale, making such policies
papers.llm_reason: πR² 针对通用操作策略的反应性-延迟权衡：动作分块流策略开环执行，无法对执行中途到达的感官输入做出反应；重新规划受限于感知-动作管线（大型骨干网络+多步去噪）的高延迟。提出的解决方案聚焦机器人操作策略的低延迟反应式控制。方法本身有工程价值，但与 LLM/Agent 软件栈的直接迁移距离较远，更多属于机器人操控领域的专用贡献。如果团队涉及具身智能/机器人 Agent，可作为架构候选跟踪；否则作为长尾资产保存。代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Collaborative System Failure Prognostics via Federated Longitudinal-Survival Modeling
papers.abstract: Time-to-event modeling provides a systematic framework for estimating time-dependent failure risk, reliability, and remaining useful life (RUL) from longitudinal condition monitoring data. However, applying these models to distributed prognostics remains challenging because sensor trajectories and failure-time records are often stored across organizations or operational sites and cannot be centrally pooled due to privacy or proprietary constraints. Moreover, the classical Cox proportional hazard
papers.llm_reason: 联邦纵向生存建模用于协作系统故障预测，解决跨组织传感器轨迹与故障时间记录无法集中汇聚的隐私问题，并放宽经典 Cox 比例风险假设。这是传统工业预测性维护方向的联邦学习方法论贡献，与当前 LLM/Agent/推理基础设施栈几乎无交集，且方法论迁移到 AI 工程场景的路径不清晰。当前不建议投入。

papers.title: Re-thinking Mammography Transfer Learning: The Dataset-Informed Transfer Learning (DITL) Framework for Breast Cancer Screening and Lesion Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Enhancing classification performance in mammography remains a persistent challenge across both small curated datasets and large-scale clinical cohorts. Conventional transfer learning approaches often neglect dataset-specific characteristics, while recent neighborhood-informed methods have been restricted to narrow tasks with rigid formulations, limiting their scalability to population-level datasets. papers.llm_reason: 针对乳腺钼靶影像的迁移学习框架（DITL），结合数据集信息改进分类与病灶诊断。这是高度垂直的医学影像应用论文，与本仓库关注的 AI Agent、推理基础设施、编码代理等方向无交集，且与既有忽略模式（医学影像分割）重合。当前不建议投入。
